title: (RHBA-2005:250) nautilus bug fix update

portal_solution:
Before applying this update, make sure that all previously-released
errata relevant to your system have been applied.  Use Red Hat
Network to download and update your packages.  To launch the Red Hat
Update Agent, use the following command:

    up2date

For information on how to install packages manually, refer to the
following Web page for the System Administration or Customization
guide specific to your system:

    http://www.redhat.com/docs/manuals/enterprise/
portal_description:
Nautilus integrates access to files, applications, media, Internet-based
resources, and the Web. Nautilus delivers a dynamic and rich user
experience. Nautilus is a free software project developed under the GNU
General Public License and is a core component of the GNOME desktop project.

Opening the properties dialog for a file could take a very long time
(several minutes). This only occurred while using NIS with several
thousands groups. This updated package utilizes a different way to retrieve
the group lists, which now optimizes performance.

All users of nautilus should upgrade to this updated package, which
resolves this issue.
